claim: A 128K tape multiload game can be built into one .nex holding every stage if all stages share the same engine code; check the interrupt handler, copy routine and back buffer per stage.

evidence.text: Six recordings surveyed, same engine in every stage, multiload; the 128K IM 2 handler pages with 7FFD and flips the screen; the race loop renders into the linear back buffer 0x6000-0x7AFF; stage blocks come from the tape with --tape-bank 8,9,11.
evidence.quote: Stage 0: six recordings surveyed; same engine in every stage, multiload.
